edbDesc: In a closed system angular momentum is constant. The conservation of angular momentum explains the angular acceleration of an ice skater as she brings her arms and legs close to the vertical axis of rotation. By bringing part of mass of her body closer to the axis she decreases her body's moment of inertia. Because angular momentum is constant the angular velocity (rotational speed) of the skater has to increase.
title: Angular Momentum Conservation
